purpose: Offline editorial procedure plans, not executable workflows or approved public responses.

procedures.title: Lost or damaged certificate
clarifying_questions: Was your certificate lost or damaged, or have you never received it?
Is this a modular qualification, and do the identity names match the examination record?

steps.prompt: Confirm that certification is the appropriate service before preparing an application.

Prepare the evidence listed in the official guideline: certificate or accepted result-slip copy, police abstract, identity evidence, Registrar of Persons confirmation and a colour passport-size photograph. Upload copies through the official application channel, not this chat.
For an applicant under 18, prepare the birth certificate and the ID of a parent or official guardian.
Include the result slips for every module or part.
Check the legal-name evidence requirements before submitting if names differ.
steps.review_gate: Reviewer must confirm applicability to the specific name-change circumstances.

steps.prompt: Use the official QMIS application route. Manual or emailed applications are not accepted by this guideline. The public poster describes registration/login, service details and attachments, submission for verification, then checking status for payment.
steps.review_gate: Verify current portal screens before giving button-by-button instructions.

steps.prompt: The recorded charter fee is KES 5,220 per letter. Follow the system-issued payment instructions after document verification.
steps.review_gate: Confirm current payment prompt before release; do not supply a guessed paybill or account.

steps.prompt: A processing-time answer requires clarification of the conflict between the guideline and charter. Do not promise a completion date.
steps.applies_when: User asks how long processing takes
steps.review_gate: Unresolved timing conflict; escalate this question.

steps.prompt: Wait for the collection notification. The owner collects in person with original ID or passport; a minor attends with a parent or official guardian and the specified originals.
For further enquiries, the guideline lists archives@knec.ac.ke and ceo@knec.ac.ke. General telephone support is 0719093000.
steps.applies_when: User is stuck or requests human assistance

procedures.completion: Guidance finished; the assistant has not submitted, paid for or approved an application.

procedures.title: Institution or employer confirmation
clarifying_questions: Which institution or employer needs confirmation?
Which examination, year and, where applicable, Business or Technical series?
Is the destination within Kenya or abroad?
Does the request cover modules or Single and Group stages?

steps.prompt: Confirm the receiving institution address. The statement goes to the employer or institution, cannot be redirected and is not a replacement certificate.
Prepare the examination identity, school or centre details and certificate evidence. Include the series for Business or Technical examinations.
If the certificate or result slip is missing, obtain an appropriate certified results printout; check the primary-examination year restrictions.
steps.applies_when: Applicant lacks certificate or accepted result-slip evidence
steps.review_gate: Verify the exact year-specific evidence before giving a complete checklist.

steps.prompt: Submit each examination separately with its supporting evidence.

Use QMIS and provide contact details for any clarification. The public poster describes registration/login, service details and attachments, submission for verification, then checking status for payment.
steps.review_gate: Verify current portal screens before button-by-button instructions.

steps.prompt: Check destination, modules and stages before quoting. The charter lists KES 2,320 within Kenya and KES 3,480 outside Kenya per certificate; module and stage charging rules can affect the total.
steps.review_gate: Resolve dispatch terminology and overseas-payment instructions before presenting a total or payment directions.

steps.prompt: Explain that the recipient institution receives the statement. Historical examinations from 1926 to 1984 may take longer.
steps.review_gate: Confirm applicable current delivery channel and timing; do not promise tracking access.

steps.prompt: Use the published archives enquiry address or general telephone support when assistance is needed.

procedures.completion: Guidance finished; the assistant has not submitted, paid for or approved an application.

procedures.title: Foreign qualification equation
clarifying_questions: Which qualification, awarding country and intended purpose?
Which institution will receive the equation letter?
What language is the certificate in?

steps.prompt: Check qualification eligibility first; the guideline excludes institutional-based certificates.
steps.review_gate: An authorized reviewer must confirm eligibility for the actual qualification; do not infer an equivalence outcome.

steps.prompt: Ask the issuing examination body to send verification directly to ceo@knec.ac.ke. For a certificate outside English or Kiswahili, the guideline names the relevant Embassy, Alliance Francaise for French, or another recognized institution for other languages for translation.
steps.review_gate: Verify current applicability; do not declare a particular unverified translation provider recognized.

steps.prompt: Prepare the request explaining purpose and destination, qualification evidence and identity documentation. Ordinary and Advanced Level applicants also need primary-level evidence.
Where equation criteria do not exist, further syllabus, assessment, sample-paper, grading and certificate evidence is required.
steps.applies_when: KNEC requires evidence because equation criteria do not exist

steps.prompt: Submit through the official QMIS route.
steps.review_gate: Verify current portal screens before button-by-button instructions.

steps.prompt: The guideline lists KES 3,480 per letter including registered mail and KES 928 additional for email dispatch. The guideline directs M-Pesa payment through the prompt in the applicant QMIS status.
steps.review_gate: Confirm the current payment prompt and requested dispatch method; timeline start remains unresolved.

steps.prompt: The equation letter is for its addressed institution and cannot be copied or redirected to the applicant or another institution.
Offer equation@knec.ac.ke, archives@knec.ac.ke or ceo@knec.ac.ke from the guideline, or the verified general support telephone.

procedures.completion: Guidance finished; the assistant has not submitted, paid for or approved an application.

procedures.title: Biodata correction: review-gated guidance
clarifying_questions: Was the detail recorded incorrectly, or did it change legally after the examination?
Which examination and year, and which document contains the error?

steps.prompt: Identify the field and the nature of the correction; do not infer eligibility from the existence of an amendment category.
steps.review_gate: Confirm current eligibility, especially legal changes versus original recording errors.

steps.prompt: The public query page identifies institutional and education-office channels. Confirm which route applies to this applicant before directing submission.
steps.review_gate: Resolve self-service versus institution-assisted submission for the specific case.

steps.prompt: Historical QMIS guidance describes reviewing existing examination details, proposing the correction, attaching required evidence and submitting. Obtain a current approved checklist before giving document or payment instructions.
steps.applies_when: After eligibility and route are confirmed
steps.review_gate: Current documents, screens, fees and deadlines are unverified; do not use the old screenshot attachment list as a current checklist.

steps.prompt: Offer general KNEC telephone support for unresolved requirements.
steps.applies_when: Guidance cannot proceed from verified evidence

procedures.completion: Review-gated orientation only; no application, payment or amendment has been performed.
